work.scope: Exact executed fitting sums including all input events, backward, losing proposals, normalization, clipping and Adam; 2 FLOPs/MAC, specials separate plus unit weight; CPU numeric clocks included; dev/RNG/traffic/energy separate

protocol.scope: Diagnostic history control knows a three-mark history bound and shares decoder across observed source addresses. Explicit mark/age/valid features; no race or counterfactual mechanisms. Same512 fit queries/four passes/U64 and data as saved native; native historical fitting remains charged. Fresh4096-query confirmation, not a real-data or energy benchmark.
